claims.statement: The retained launch walkthrough explicitly states that visitors are randomized and player experience may differ.
The observed Level 1 route progresses through documents, body scanning, photography, certificates, isolation, city monitoring, organ imaging, thermal scanning, and bone imaging by Day 14.
The observed Level 2 route adds UV paper inspection and introduces blood sample analysis on Day 21.
The observed Level 3 route adds an answer-based test on Day 25, blood type on Day 29, and the branching timeline after Day 30.
Official material supports the underlying progression from document and clearance checks to more accurate identity tests, quarantine, anomaly investigation, and city containment.

unknowns: Post-Day-30 ending routes and exact conditions are not sufficiently verified.
Reported purchases, earnings, and mistakes are player-specific and are not universal recommendations.
Patch and branching state may change individual shift presentation.
